name: Art Club President
source:
Her name is unknown. She is a sixth-year student as well as the president of the Art Club. She is troubled over the declining in the number of members in the Art Club. Has a very straightforward personality. [url=/c1200]Tsukasa[/url] works part-time at the sushi bar which is owned by her family, as well as her residence.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fortune_Arterial]Wikipedia[/url].]
